correctness.rationale: With independent identical continuous edge priorities the next accepted edge is uniform among the edges on uncovered vertices, by deferred exposure of the permutation. For p intact forbidden pairs and s singletons the counts of the three unordered endpoint types are binom(s,2), 2ps and 2p(p−1) and exhaust the eligible edges. An even uncovered set of size at least four always has a feasible edge; at size two it jams exactly for a deleted pair. A given intact pair has 2(m−2) incident eligible edges at size m; the one-step survival bounds telescope to (1). Two specified intact pairs have 4m−12 incident eligible edges; summing the exponential bound over even m gives the stated harmonic factor and E[Q_k(Q_k−1)]=O(k⁴/n²). With exactly one pair left the telescoping survival product equals 3/(4k²−1). Bounding the probability of two or more intact pairs by half the factorial moment gives (3); the main term is 3/(4n), and k=floor(n^(1/5)) balances 1/(nk) and k⁴/n². The expectation of the uncovered fraction is P_n/n. Independent exact recursion on labeled subsets reproduced P_2 through P_5 and computed P_6=562248/6062875 and P_7=634107503/7766542875; replay with python3 /workspace/branches/d8630442-8c97-4819-862c-7b8a4e34c368/subset_dp_check.py. The supplied verification files were inspected, not executed; the bounded table does not establish the limit.
